speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis

The rash you mentioned could be a reaction to the antibiotic that was actually treating a different issue, or unrelated; however, the persistence of fever and flank pain alongside your recent upper respiratory infection strongly suggests an ascending urinary tract infection. Did you experience burning or urgency when urinating before the antibiotics were even started?
